detailed_descriptions.en: Smashing Bottles is a short and satisfying incremental game where you break bottles to earn money, upgrade your bat, discover new bottles, and cause chaos! Will you smash enough bottles to buy the universe? Smash Bottles! Buy Upgrades! Discover New Bottles! Use your money to buy special bottles that increase your profits! Buy the Universe! To cause more chaos, spend your shards to prestige and obtain SUPER powerful upgrades in exchange for resetting your run. Idle Mode Play the alternate Idle gamemode for a a longer, more chill experience. Features: Satisfying glass smashing gameplay Round based incremental progress Skill tree progression Prestige system with unique upgrades Discoverable bottle types with unique mechanics Alternate Idle gamemode Secrets that unlock cosmetics for your bat and bottles Banging soundtrack!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Smashing Bottles is a short and satisfying incremental game where you break bottles to earn money, upgrade your bat, discover new bottles, and cause chaos! Will you smash enough bottles to buy the universe?

Smash Bottles!

Buy Upgrades!

Discover New Bottles!

Use your money to buy special bottles that increase your profits!

Buy the Universe!

To cause more chaos, spend your shards to prestige and obtain SUPER powerful upgrades in exchange for resetting your run.

Idle Mode

Play the alternate Idle gamemode for a a longer, more chill experience.

Features:

  • Satisfying glass smashing gameplay

  • Round based incremental progress

  • Skill tree progression

  • Prestige system with unique upgrades

  • Discoverable bottle types with unique mechanics

  • Alternate Idle gamemode

  • Secrets that unlock cosmetics for your bat and bottles

  • Banging soundtrack!
